body:
Thanks for the very quick response. 

For (2), I've tried for several hours to fix the errors on lensfun-convert-lcp to add the lens lcp profile to my local lensfun database. I seem to have fixed the python multiprocessing error which has been reported elsewhere, but there are still errors:

```
    self.calibration_entries = [self.get_description_element_maybe(entry) for entry in tree.getroot()[0][0][0][0]]
                                                                                       ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^^^
IndexError: child index out of range
```
The error seems to indicate that Adobe may have revised the lcp format since the conversion utility was last updated.

I'll learn to be more effective with profiles / presets, and if that remains too cumbersome, I may raise a feature request. Thanks.
